ratio.description: Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical for social, 16:9 landscape.

duration_s.description: Total length in seconds after transitions. Beats share it by weight.

beats.description: One entry per scene, in order. hook and cta carry text only, number carries a figure, compare carries bars.

id.description: Optional scene id (used in every data-mosio-id). Defaults to the role name; a repeated role gets -2, -3.

role.description: What this beat does in the story; picks the scene template.

text.description: The words on screen, written literally into the scene HTML.

key.description: The word or words of the text to stress with the accent colour. Must occur in the text.

weight.description: Relative screen time of this beat.

value.description: For a number beat: the figure that counts up.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point of the figure.

prefix.description: Text printed before the figure, for example a currency sign.

unit.description: Text printed after the figure or after each bar value, for example k, % or M.

items.description: For a compare beat: the bars, in order. The largest is drawn in the accent colour.

label.description: Short label under the bar or beside it.

value.description: The bar's value. Bars are scaled to the largest value.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point in the printed value.

style.description: Look: brand colours, type size and motion speed.

brand.description: Brand colours. They are written to shared/tokens.css, so changing one re-renders every scene.

bg.description: Background colour of every scene (--bg in shared/tokens.css).

main.description: Main brand colour: large shapes and the key surface (--main).

accent.description: Accent colour for the one thing that matters on screen: key word, winner bar, price (--accent).

text_on_accent.description: Text colour used on top of the accent colour, for example on a button (--text-on-accent).

font_scale.description: Multiplier on every type size (--type-scale). 1 is the designed size; check `mosio inspect` for overflow above 1.

pacing.description: Speed of the motion inside each scene: calm slows entrances by about 30 percent, brisk speeds them by about 25 percent. Scene lengths do not change.

files.content:
# data-infographic

A headline, one big figure that counts up, and a bar chart that grows from one baseline. Everything is plain HTML, so every number and label is editable text and inspectable by `mosio inspect`.

Source: the chart scene of `fixtures/w3-promo`, re-authored with DOM bars and Web Animations-compatible CSS instead of a canvas.

## Beats
| role | template | looks like | limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hook`, `cta`, `proof` | `scenes/title.html` | a rule draws in, the headline rises, the key word takes the accent colour | 8 words |
| `number` | `scenes/number.html` | giant figure counts up with the seek clock, caption fades in below | 6 words, needs `value` |
| `compare` | `scenes/bars.html` | 2 to 6 bars grow in sequence, the largest in the accent colour, values appear when a bar lands | 6 words, needs `items` |

`number` beats take `value`, `decimals`, `prefix` and `unit`. `compare` beats take `items` (`label`, `value`, optional `decimals`) and a shared `unit`. Bars are scaled to the largest value in the beat. Labels are at most 12 characters.

## The controls worth changing first
- `style.brand.accent`: the winning bar and the figure. `style.brand.main`: all other bars and units.
- `style.pacing`: speed of the count-up and bar growth.
- `content.beats[n].items[m].value`: edit one data point; only the compare scene re-renders.

## Taste
- One number per scene. If two numbers fight, make two beats.
- Order bars in the order of the story (time, rank), not by size, unless size is the story.
- State the unit once, in the beat (`unit`), not in every label.
- End with a short `cta` or `proof` beat so the chart is not the last frame.

## After applying
The result is an ordinary Mosio project: edit words in place, change a brand token in `shared/tokens.css` and only the scenes that import it re-render.

# Data infographic: beat plan

Length 8 to 45 s (default 14). Roles: hook, number, compare, proof, cta; 2 to 6 beats.
Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.8, long 3.6.

## hook / cta / proof

- scene: scenes/title.html
- technique: headline rises in over an accent rule; the key word takes the accent colour
- primitives: rise-fade, bar-draw
- limits: {"max_words": 8}

## number

- scene: scenes/number.html
- technique: giant figure counts up with the seek clock, caption fades in beneath
- primitives: count-up, rise-fade
- limits: {"max_words": 6}

## compare

- scene: scenes/bars.html
- technique: bars grow from one baseline in sequence, the largest in the accent colour, values appear when a bar lands
- primitives: bar-grow, rise-fade
- limits: {"items_max": 6, "items_min": 2, "max_words": 6}

## Controls

- Highlight colour (`/style/brand/accent`): Recolours the winning bar, the figure and accent words: --accent in shared/tokens.css.
- Bar colour (`/style/brand/main`): Recolours all non-winning bars: --main in shared/tokens.css.
- Pacing (`/style/pacing`): Speeds or slows the count-up and bar growth: --pace in shared/tokens.css.
- A data value (`/content/beats/2/items/5/value`): Edit one bar: its value and its height live in the compare scene's HTML, so only that scene re-renders.
